name: Varrock Sewers - Scurrius lair
accessNote: Enter Varrock Sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace and continue east to the broken bars. The free private instance contains the weaker solo form; the public arena contains the stronger group form. Group Ironmen can share an instance. Exit through the sewage water; re-entry has an approximately 15-second delay. Cannons and fires are prohibited. The Wiki includes Blood Barrage as a magic alternative in this multicombat area; this is not a safespot. Graves appear beside Historian Aldo outside the lair.
